seeding.positions1to8: Previous cup champion #1; previous Serie A champion #2 or league runner-up if same club; UEFA qualifiers by league order and eighth-ranked club when applicable
seeding.positions9to24: Remaining 12 current Serie A clubs, three previous Serie A relegated clubs, losing Serie B promotion playoff finalist
seeding.positions37to39: Three Serie C group winners promoted to Serie B
seeding.position40: Serie C national promotion playoff winner
seeding.serieCReplacement: Best eligible club(s) from second national playoff round under art.49 NOIF when group runner-up promoted or cup winner overlaps, relegated, or cup not held
seeding.sameOwnership: League may adjust bracket to prevent meeting before final

rules.finalVenue: Normally Stadio Olimpico, Rome; alternative venue by league decision

sharedGroundPriority.preliminaryThroughSedicesimi: Lower seed number retains home, other venue inverted
sharedGroundPriority.ottaviAndQuarterfinal: Previous cup winner, then better previous league ranking; other venue inverted
sharedGroundPriority.semifinal: Previous cup winner, then better previous league ranking hosts return leg; other hosts first leg

otherInversionConditions: Joint written club request at least three days before match

discipline.yellowCardResetAfterSedicesimi: Regulation requests federal authorization; actual federal decision to confirm
